divergences.summary: Use the complete static Seti mapping through the original FileIconThemeLoader; replace only its font resource path with the bundled artifact URL. Mount the resulting CSS inside the existing editor scope with a disposable constructed sheet for CSP. No extension loading or configurable icon theme is introduced.

verification.obligation: Real sandboxed Electron verification of completion acceptance and undo, diagnostics, computed hover/control geometry, Settings and JSON title icons, both view-switch tooltips, packaged font loading and theme transitions.
